Definition: from G3319 and G4215; Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare H763), a region of Asia:--Mesopotamia.
BiblicalUsage: Mesopotamia is the land between the rivers, the Euphrates and the Tigris, where Abraham began. Acts 7:2 says the God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran, and Acts 2:9 lists the dwellers in Mesopotamia among those who heard the gospel at Pentecost.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mesopotamia holds the whole story in miniature: the call began there, and the gospel returned there at Pentecost.
